upstream.description: what happens upstream to a matched message on a binary connection MockServer relays to an upstream (matchBinaryExpectationsWhenProxying): ANSWER_ONLY (the default) writes binaryData and does not forward the message; ANSWER_AND_FORWARD writes binaryData, forwards the message and drops the upstream's reply; FORWARD_AND_REPLACE forwards the message and writes binaryData in place of the upstream's reply. The last two need binaryMessageFraming POSTGRESQL; without it a match answers as ANSWER_ONLY
